accepted_claims: Finite sparse node/sign samples do not determine sub-cell positive material or topology, so sampling resolution cannot be sole canonical material authority.
Sampling/reconstruction, resampling and extraction error are separate from inherited source-sweep error and must be accumulated explicitly.
Refinement may reduce a certified uncertainty envelope but cannot by itself establish exact equality, topology, durable body identity or lineage.
Sparse volume/level-set methods remain eligible as bounded derived accelerators/challengers only behind an independently certified source/material relation and explicit fail-closed uncertainty.
open_claims: PB-007-03 remains OPEN_PROPAGATED for a universal exact source codec covering arbitrary admitted form/undercut cutters.
RB-016-02 remains OPEN for durable multi-body mapping and independent engineering-output preservation.
RB-016-03 remains OPEN for native STEP preservation of certified positive micro-material.
RB-016-04 remains OPEN for exact-zero/touching/singular engineering output without healing or tolerance fusion.
No native sparse-volume provider has been qualified for robustness, scale or production use in this task.
MC-B, MC-C, MC-D, MC-E, MC-F and MC-1 remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
adversarial_controls: reject same-sign cell corners as proof that the cell contains no positive sub-cell feature
reject pitch/refinement convergence as exact-equality or topology authority
reject omission or reset of inherited source-sweep error
reject silent omission of resampling or extraction error
reject binary-float/tolerance deletion of exact positive material
reject tolerance fusion of tangent, penetrating and separated material events
reject voxel/level-set components as durable body identity or lineage
reject extracted mesh/isosurface as primary STEP success
reject closure of PB-007-03 or RB-016-02/03/04 without producing-owner evidence
reject native-capability or MC-B promotion from deterministic model evidence
reject timeout/resource refusal/UNCERTIFIED as solved material

review.disposition: negative candidate result: reject finite sparse sampled/narrow-band volume or level-set state as sole canonical material/engineering-output authority; retain only a bounded derived accelerator/challenger role behind independent source/material certification, explicit accumulated error and separate topology/body witnesses
review.downstream_release: MC-026 may consume MC-029 as negative candidate evidence; MC-030 may compare retained bounded roles, but MC-029 does not release MC-B or authorize native execution

downstream_invalidations: Any use of grid pitch, band width, sample density or extraction success as authority to erase positive material or decide exact-zero contact invalidates the retained role.
Any error budget that resets inherited source error or omits sampling, resampling or extraction terms invalidates certification.
Any promotion of voxel/level-set component identity to durable body/lineage, or extracted mesh/isosurface to primary STEP success, invalidates the MC-029 boundary.
A future native campaign may qualify bounded implementation robustness/performance but cannot rewrite this deterministic representational negative result without a prospective contract review.
